name: opencode-bridge
description: Talk to the opencode v2 sessions running on this Mac: list them, attach to the one in progress, read its history, send follow-up prompts, and review diffs.

interface.shortDescription: Talk to your local OpenCode agent
interface.longDescription: Connects ChatGPT to the opencode v2 sessions running on this Mac. List existing sessions, attach to the one already in progress instead of starting a new one, read its transcript, post follow-up instructions into the same session, poll for completion, and review diffs. Permission requests are surfaced for a human decision and are never auto-approved.
defaultPrompt: Ask my OpenCode agent what it's working on
Read the latest messages from my existing OpenCode session
Tell my OpenCode agent to investigate this and report back
